items.title: J.J. McCarthy: Struggles with accuracy in win
items.text:
McCarthy completed 18 of 38 passes for 173 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions and rushed seven times for 33 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.

items.title: Isaiah Likely: Limited to one catch in win
items.text:
Likely brought in one of three targets for 35 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.

items.title: Jakobi Meyers: Season-high yardage total in loss
items.text:
Meyers brought in four of 10 targets for 85 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.

items.title: Trevor Lawrence: Comes up short against Giants
items.text:
Lawrence completed 25 of 47 passes for 301 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and rushed three times for seven yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday. He also fumbled twice but recovered.

items.title: Courtland Sutton: Goes without catch in Week 11
items.text:
